criteria.requirement: The tool must provide a drag-and-drop 2D pier canvas for selecting ship class, pier number, and line types. A physics-informed agent ingests mock hydrographic data (wind velocity, ebb/flood current) and iteratively evaluates mooring line geometry and bollard strain against NSTM 582 limits. The agent must recommend optimal tug assist horsepower, line sequences, and issue warnings when wind gusts threaten breaking line thresholds.
criteria.detail: Authoritative equations, NSTM revision, capacities, thresholds and optimization objective are absent. Planned synthetic intake/layout is only a demonstrated slice.
No authoritative equations, signed cases or approved tolerances supplied. Toolkit fixtures cannot verify application engineering.

criteria.requirement: Reject inconsistent units and missing inputs.
criteria.detail: Approved conversion rules, physical ranges and craft definitions are absent. Planned completeness and structural unit/configuration checks cannot satisfy the whole criterion.

The self-contained offline review screen shows missing engineering authority and unknown uncertainty, requires explicit acknowledgement of a saved synthetic scenario revision, blocks review of unsaved edits, invalidates acknowledgement on changed saved content and never grants operational approval. Qualified human authority is preserved by keeping engineering decisions unavailable. — demonstrated by review-synthetic, recover-missing, recover-stale-review at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: An interactive web application outputting an approved Mooring Evolution Safety Sheet and graphical layout, complete with agent rationale and safety margins. Deliverables include a demo walkthrough and a 1-page fielding brief.
criteria.detail: Approved sheet schema, approval process and engineering basis are absent. The planned marked synthetic summary/layout, walkthrough and brief demonstrate only a limited slice.
